description: **Assembly Stage 2.** New `selfdoc assembly generate-shared` command and rewritten assembly workflow for multi-project site aggregation. Each dispatch now surgically updates one project, regenerates shared elements (homepage, blog index, nav, feeds, sitemap, search), commits the combined site, and deploys.
**CF Pages deploy fix.** Deploy to the correct Cloudflare Pages project name (`smmh` instead of `docs-smmh-dev`).
